gaps.note: Bit-reversed ordering is a named permutation of the input indices that the page neither defines nor links. The reader cannot tell which order the input must be in, so the claim that the last level then leaves A_0 to A_{n-1} in order cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: The source builds its tape-level transform the same way, from (cited).
gaps.note: The page does not say how butterflies and the address rearrangements and shifts are composed into a multitape procedure. The cited source is given as the only account of the tape-level construction, so the claim that it is built the same way stands in for how the transform works on tapes and cannot be checked from the page.

gaps.quote: the pair at offsets $t$ and $t+h/2$ uses $s=tn/h$.
gaps.note: The page never states that the sub-transforms at block size h use the root omega^{n/h}. Without that, the reader cannot see why the butterfly exponent is tn/h rather than the top-level m, so the per-level exponent is asserted rather than derived.
